summary: CI run 3: fix a wrong test expectation; add a 500 safety net so an unexpected handler exception is logged and answered instead of dropping the connection; make the packaged smoke script print backend exit status and stderr/backend.log on failure. The Windows disconnect itself is undiagnosed (inferred only).
scope_note: Fourth commit on worktree windows-release (after 486825b). files lists this commit's paths.

budget_impact.rationale: Packaging, file locking and paths only; no model call, prompt, retry, network call or data leaving the machine. CI builds use no secrets.
budget_impact.after: macOS and Windows x64 builds; same zero-token core

additional_checks.scope: smoke script end to end against the source backend on macOS; not a packaged binary

open_risks: Cause of the Windows RemoteDisconnected is not known; the next CI run is expected to print it.
The 500 fallback changes behaviour only for previously-unhandled exceptions; an error body 'internal error' carries no detail by design.
